svg.title: memory-gate, a real run on Windows 11, 14 Nov 2026
svg.desc: Terminal, a real run: node tools/guards/memory-gate/memory-gate.mjs. Notes: One line instead of a process list: 286 bytes: a verdict, the reading behind it (96.2% of this machine's memory is committed) and advice in plain words. Exit code 4 means stop: Your agent branches on the number and never has to parse the text: 0 go ahead, 3 one heavy job at a time, 4 stop, 5 could not tell.
